details.method: Capture an immutable policy and input binding before executing a check, persist it with the run, and compare the original binding at evidence recording rather than relabeling results with the latest policy.
details.when: Real asynchronous validation writes reusable facts while the trusted host can update installed rules.
details.counterexample: Comparing a policy only before the recording call leaves a race; passing a self-declared result without authenticated runner authorization is not acceptable.
details.trial_plan: At future adoption change rule version and nested scope during a real subprocess, immediately before record and after binding construction; require no hit under new rules, preserved old binding and restart writeback without process repetition.
